name: web-fintech-site-on-laptop-atop-white-plinth-with-window-light
title: Fintech site on a laptop perched on a white cube against a grey tiled wall with light patches
whatItIs: A laptop showing a white fintech site with a blue accent and a smiling woman sits on a stepped white block against a grey grid-tiled wall with window light and shadow.
whatItMeans: Clean and precise; grey stage and light patches feel like a gallery.
techniques: Place the device on a plinth in a monochrome room.
Cast window-light shapes across the wall.
Keep the screen the only colour.
Use a tiled wall for a subtle grid.

vocabulary.definition: A mockup styled like a museum display.
Shaped light patches from a window.
A block used as a stand.
A scene in one neutral colour.
